editorial:
Ever wonder what happened to the kid of a legendary hero? You get to follow Jack Jr., who is stuck in the shadow of his famous dad, Jack the Giant Killer. Instead of just accepting his fate, he decides to take matters into his own hands by growing his own massive beanstalk. The whole vibe is lighthearted and goofy, feeling like a classic family adventure from the 90s. You will meet some really weird and funny characters as Jack climbs higher and higher, making the journey feel like a wild road trip but in the clouds. It is a sweet story about a son trying to find his father and prove that he has the same guts as the original legend.

The acting is charming and the pacing keeps you moving, though some of the special effects look a bit dated now. That is part of the charm, though! If you love old-school fantasy comedies, you will have a blast with this one. It is a great pick for a rainy Sunday afternoon with the family. You should definitely look for it to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: After a huge battle in the clouds, Jack Jr. finally finds his father and saves him from the giants. The big twist is that the giants were not just mean, but actually quite clumsy and easily tricked. Jack uses his wits to outsmart them and bring his dad back home safely. They chop down the beanstalk together, ensuring no more giants can come down, and the family finally reunites for a happy ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves nostalgic family adventures and funny fairy tales.
